Rent 8k

Let’s do the real math for ₹8,000 monthly rent.

Step 1: Annual rent needed

₹8,000 × 12 = ₹96,000/year

Step 2: Dividend corpus needed

Depends on dividend yield:

5% yield → ₹96,000 ÷ 0.05 = ₹19.2 lakh corpus
6% yield → ₹16 lakh corpus
7% yield → ₹13.7 lakh corpus
8% yield → ₹12 lakh corpus

So ₹12–14 lakh only works if you consistently get ~7–8% dividend yield, which is not guaranteed and may not be stable.

For a safer estimate, I’d say:

₹15–20 lakh corpus is more realistic for ₹8k/month rent through dividends.

Step 3: Monthly SIP till 2030

Assuming ~5 years and ~12% annual return:

To build:

₹15 lakh corpus → approx ₹18k–20k SIP/month
₹20 lakh corpus → approx ₹24k–27k SIP/month

A better YouTube reply would be:

“₹8,000 rent cover karne ke liye approx ₹15–20 lakh dividend corpus lag sakta hai (yield pe depend karega) 😊

2030 tak build karna ho toh roughly ₹18k–25k monthly SIP range helpful ho sakti hai 🙌

(Exact number returns aur stock selection pe depend karegi)
